cases.expected: MessageSourceValidationMessage.Builder instance whose schemaNode equals the non‑null JsonNode supplied to the validator constructor
cases.description: Verify that when the validator is constructed with a concrete JsonNode (e.g., an ObjectNode representing {"type":"string"}), the overridden message() method returns a builder that has its schemaNode property set to that same JsonNode.

cases.expected: MessageSourceValidationMessage.Builder instance whose schemaNode is null
cases.description: Verify that when the validator is constructed with a null schemaNode, the overridden message() method still returns a builder and the builder's schemaNode property is null (i.e., the method forwards the null reference without throwing).

cases.expected: Two successive calls to message() return distinct Builder objects (different object references)
cases.description: Ensure that each invocation of message() creates a fresh Builder rather than reusing a cached instance, confirming that super.message() is called on every call.

cases.expected: MessageSourceValidationMessage.Builder instance whose schemaNode is the Jackson NullNode singleton (JsonNode instance representing JSON null)
cases.description: Create a concrete subclass of BaseJsonValidator passing `JsonNode schemaNode = NullNode.getInstance()` to the constructor. Invoke `message()` and verify that the returned builder’s `schemaNode` property is exactly the same NullNode instance (i.e., `builder.schemaNode() == NullNode.getInstance()`). This tests that the method correctly propagates a non‑object, non‑array JsonNode that represents JSON null.

cases.expected: MessageSourceValidationMessage.Builder instance whose schemaNode is the same mutable ArrayNode reference supplied at construction time
cases.description: Instantiate a concrete BaseJsonValidator with an `ArrayNode` containing a few numeric elements (e.g., `[1,2,3]`). Call `message()` to obtain a builder and assert that `builder.schemaNode()` returns the exact same `ArrayNode` object (reference equality). Then mutate the original `ArrayNode` (e.g., add another element) and verify that the builder’s `schemaNode` reflects the mutation, confirming that the builder stores the reference rather than a copy.

cases.expected: MessageSourceValidationMessage.Builder instance whose MessageSource is the default implementation (`DefaultMessageSource`)
cases.description: Construct a validator with any schemaNode (null or non‑null). After calling `message()`, retrieve the builder’s `messageSource` (or equivalent accessor) and assert that it is an instance of `DefaultMessageSource`. This ensures that the overridden `message()` method does not replace the default message source supplied by `super.message()`.
